definition: Stations, sensors and networks that observe weather, climate, water or environmental conditions (weather stations, hydrological gauges, air or water quality monitoring). Does not include the platforms that store and process the data, or forecasting.
Systems and models that produce weather, climate, flood, drought or other hazard forecasts or projections. Does not include the observation networks that feed them or the dissemination of warnings.

Databases and platforms that store, integrate and process climate, weather or environmental data. Does not include observation networks, forecasting models, or services that package information for users.
Bringing weather or climate data into health or disease surveillance systems to monitor or predict climate-sensitive illness. Does not include issuing disease warnings (that is early warning).

Services that package climate information into products for decision makers or the public (bulletins, portals of climate information, sector advisories). Does not include data platforms without a user-facing product, or hazard warnings (early warning).
Monitors environmental conditions relevant to climate risk
